scope: Post-hoc information-availability comparison only; never a fly circuit, actor, biological claim or deployment gate
objective: Unweighted MSE on every original valid TRAIN left-turn target; deterministic full batch; no recurrent state
normalization: Original valid TRAIN rows only; no development statistics
selection: Fixed last epoch200 for both variants; no development fitting, early stopping or hyperparameter search
limitations: Development outcomes already known from prior comparisons; this is exploratory diagnosis, not held-out confirmation. Capacity and optimizer differ from biological model. No evaluation-role data, actuator or UI use.
